findings.title: Hands clean and properly washed.
findings.comment: Observed no barrier to be used when hand washing. Discussed with PIC, education was provided on proper hand washing and hands were rewashed. Ensure a barrier is used when washing hands to prevent any possible contamination.
findings.citation_text: 2-301.12(C) Cleaning Procedure. (C) To avoid recontaminating their hands or surrogate prosthetic devices, FOOD EMPLOYEES may use disposable paper towels or similar clean barriers when touching surfaces such as manually operated faucet handles on a HANDWASHING SINK or the handle of a restroom door.

findings.title: Proper date marking and disposition.
findings.comment: Observed cut tomatoes to be held past date marking maximum. Discussed with PIC, tomatoes will be discarded. Ensure any TCS item is discarded after its 7 day date marking maximum.
findings.citation_text: 3-501.18(A) Ready-to-Eat, Time/Temperature Control for Safety Food, Disposition. (A) A FOOD specified in 3-501.17(A) or (B) shall be discarded if it: (1) Exceeds the temperature and time combination specified in 3-501.17(A), except time that the product is frozen; (2) Is in a container or PACKAGE that does not bear a date or day; or (3) Is inappropriately marked with a date or day that exceeds a temperature and time combination as specified in 3-501.17(A).

findings.title: Adequate handwashing sinks properly supplied and accessible
findings.comment:
(REPEAT x2) Observed an empty sanitizer bucket in the hand sink. The hand sink should not be blocked. Ensure staff is aware. Inspector moved the item. COS. 

5-205.11: (A) A HANDWASHING SINK shall be maintained so that it is accessible at all times for EMPLOYEE use. (B) A HANDWASHING SINK may not be used for purposes other than handwashing. (C) An automatic handwashing facility shall be used in accordance with manufacturer’s instructions.

findings.title: Proper date marking and disposition
findings.comment:
Observed multiple items in the cooler next to the fryer to not have date marking available. Discussed with PIC, said items were discarded. Ensure staff is date marking any TCS foods. 

3-501.18: (A) FOOD shall be discarded if exceeding temperature and time criteria. If container or PACKAGE does not bear a date or day or if inappropriately marked with date or day exceeding temperature and time combination. (B) Refrigerated RTE TCS FOOD prepared in FOOD ESTABLISHMENT and dispensed through vending machine shall be discarded if exceeding temperature and time.

findings.title: Insects, rodents, and animals not present
findings.comment:
Observed multiple flies throughout the facility. Discussed with PIC, ensure kitchen is kept pest free and flies are no longer present. 

There is an air curtain fan present by the main service window that was not able to be turned on during inspection. Ensure repairs are made so equipment can be used to prevent unwanted pests. 

6-501.111: PREMISE shall be maintained free of insects, rodents, and other pests. If present (A) Routinely inspect shipments of FOOD and supplies (B) Inspect PREMISE routinely (C) Using methods, such as trapping devices Pf (D) Eliminate harborage conditions.

findings.title: Food and non-food contact surfaces cleanable, properly designed, constructed, and used
findings.comment:
Observed the outside bottom edge and the floor of the walk in cooler to be rusting and in need of repair. Discussed with PIC, ensure equipment is smooth and easily cleanable. 

4-202.16: NonFOOD-CONTACT SURFACES shall be free of unnecessary ledges, projections, and crevices, and designed and constructed to allow easy cleaning and to facilitate maintenance.

findings.title: Warewashing facilities: installed, maintained, & used; test strips
findings.comment:
Observed no test strips for Quat sanitizer. Discussed with PIC, ensure facility has test strips available at all hours of operation. 

4-302.14: A test kit or other device that accurately measures the concentration in MG/L of SANITIZING solutions shall be provided.

findings.title: Warewashing facilities: installed, maintained, & used; test strips
findings.comment:
Observed no sani bucket present at beginning of the inspection. Sani bucket was empty and within the hand sink. Discussed with PIC, sani bucket was made upon request. One tablet was initially added to the bucket, however it only tested at 100 ppm so a second tablet was added. 

4-303.11: (A) Cleaning agents used to clean EQUIPMENT shall be provided and available during all hours of operation. (B) Chemical SANITIZERS shall be provided and available during all hours of operation.

findings.title: Physical facilities installed, maintained, and clean
findings.comment:
Observed the following areas in need of cleaning:
1) The ceiling air vents have an accumulation of dust.
2) The flooring below and the wall behind the fryers have an accumulation of dirt, grease and food debris. 

Discussed with PIC, ensure facility is being cleaned at a frequency that prevents accumulation of dust, grease, and food debris. 

6-501.11: PHYSICAL FACILITIES shall be maintained in good repair.
